backlog.title: Merge approved architecture and hardened bootstrap
backlog.objective: Establish the reviewed architecture, decisions, bootstrap tools, security/operations plans, schemas, monitoring, preflight, review, and smoke tests.

backlog.title: Implement PAF wire identity and canonical form
backlog.objective: Implement semantic identity, immutable revision identity, restricted JSON encoding, canonical byte profile, typed digests, registry/negotiation, migration envelope, and cross-language conformance vectors.

backlog.title: Internalize active phase identity and monitoring
backlog.objective: Represent generation, task review, revision, implementation, validation, and exact-head review with durable run/phase identity and reliable active/historical status.

backlog.title: Internalize typed validation activities and receipts
backlog.objective: Promote structured executable/argument authorization, shell-free production validation, and detailed authorization/execution receipts into stable PAF validation contracts.

backlog.title: Implement prerequisite preflight and explicit block operations
backlog.objective: Bind tasks to required decisions and exact base, reject unresolved prerequisites before implementation, and separate retry, revision, prerequisite resolution, regeneration, reconciliation, replanning, and termination.

backlog.title: Implement partial-work manifests and compatible recovery
backlog.objective: Capture exact partial work, completed criteria, validations, assumptions, and external effects; assess compatibility before reuse and preserve attempt lineage.

backlog.title: Implement minimal kernel contract event and error envelope
backlog.objective: Implement common revisioned objects, schema/version behavior, typed relations, accepted events, causal metadata, error/block records, and conformance fixtures.

backlog.title: Implement classification redaction and ContextPackage contracts
backlog.objective: Implement data labels, source/context snapshots, release/redaction decisions, ContextPackage identity, transformation lineage, and untrusted-content handling.

backlog.title: Instrument the existing bootstrap as a shadow PAF control runtime
backlog.objective: Emit normalized attempt, phase, activity, tool, validation, review, route, budget, and evidence records for real bootstrap work without transferring controller authority.

backlog.title: Implement status projections and runtime conformance fixtures
backlog.objective: Provide read-only status/health projections and conformance scenarios for success, provider block, timeout, stale process, repeated actions, interruption, resume, and historical display.

backlog.title: Implement durable local ledger checkpoints backup and recovery
backlog.objective: Implement SQLite WAL ledger, content-addressed blobs, migrations, snapshots, leases, idempotent commands, checkpoints, replay, backup/restore, failure injection, and reconciliation.

backlog.title: Implement durable monitoring and alert records
backlog.objective: Build projections for phase health, queue age, cost, churn, blocks, reviewer disagreement, evidence completeness, recovery, and privacy-safe OpenTelemetry correlation.

backlog.title: Implement secure local control runtime and effect boundary
backlog.objective: Implement process/tool supervision, workspace bounds, network/package policy, secret references, cancellation, resource budgets, effect classes, commit-time authorization, receipts, cleanup, and forensic evidence.

backlog.title: Implement Cline as the first conforming coding-agent adapter
backlog.objective: Map Cline planning, implementation, tools, workspaces, outputs, checkpoints, and reviews to PAF contracts while retaining controller-owned publication.

backlog.title: Implement capability routing bindings and multidimensional budgets
backlog.objective: Implement capability requests, evidence-bearing route candidates, exact bindings, local/remote routes, health, reservations, deterministic selection, explicit fallback, and budget accounting.

backlog.title: Implement assessment completion recovery decisions and package profiles
backlog.objective: Implement AssessmentProtocol, criterion and independence assessment, completion, circuit breakers, bounded recovery/switch decisions, and Audit/Evidence/Reproduction/Completion PackageManifest profiles.

backlog.title: Implement deterministic retrieval and immutable ContextPackages
backlog.objective: Implement source/index snapshots, exact path/symbol/relation lookup, SQLite FTS5, retrieval audit, role-specific context assembly, staleness, and retrieval benchmarks without a mandatory vector framework.

backlog.title: Implement one governed read-only MCP adapter
backlog.objective: Map a pinned local read-only MCP server into PAF tool/resource descriptors, context release policy, prompt-injection defenses, receipts, and audit without trusting server declarations.

backlog.title: Implement Semantic Work Graph and bounded hierarchical planning
backlog.objective: Implement objectives, requirements, Work Proposals, accepted graph mutations, planner/critic protocol, duplication/coverage checks, scheduling, graph-growth limits, no-progress detection, and bounded child generation.

backlog.title: Run the first bounded self-hosted PAF coding campaign
backlog.objective: Use the local Cline adapter to generate, critique, implement, validate, repair, assess, and package one bounded PAF feature while merge remains human-controlled.

backlog.title: Implement OpenHands as a second coding-agent adapter
backlog.objective: Execute the same portable WorkItem and assessment contracts through a materially different typed coding-agent/workspace runtime.

backlog.title: Run cross-runtime semantic conformance
backlog.objective: Demonstrate equivalent task identity, context, effects, recovery, evidence, and completion across Cline and OpenHands adapters.

backlog.title: Run the first portable hierarchical self-hosted campaign
backlog.objective: Exercise dynamic Work Graph proposals, retrieval, route changes, redaction, monitoring, stalls, recovery, independent review, and package generation across supported adapters.

backlog.title: Implement a LangGraph control-backend adapter
backlog.objective: Compile bounded PAF adaptive graphs to LangGraph checkpoints, interrupts, subgraphs, and replay without transferring semantic authority.

backlog.title: Cut over normal control and prepare standalone extraction
backlog.objective: Remove duplicate authoritative bootstrap orchestration, retain recovery/doctor tooling, stabilize public APIs and packaging, add rollback, and rehearse standalone extraction.
